elements.title: 1917 Łódź City Council election (Wikipedia — did you know?)
elements.contents: ... that socialists received 31 percent of the vote in the 1917 Łódź City Council election (campaign poster pictured), but the system implemented by the German occupying authorities only gave them 8 percent of the seats?

elements.title: Jewish dairy restaurant (Wikipedia — did you know?)
elements.contents: ... that Leon Trotsky frequented a Jewish dairy restaurant in the Bronx but refused to tip, and the waiters retaliated by spilling hot soup on him?

elements.title: Roger Farmer (Wikipedia — did you know?)
elements.contents: ... that Roger Farmer, the first NFL player from Barbados, reached the league after playing for schools that a newspaper described as having "terrible records"?

elements.title: 2024 Ohio Issue 1 (Wikipedia — did you know?)

elements.title: Marina Kondratyeva (Wikipedia — did you know?)
elements.contents: ... that ballerina Marina Kondratyeva served the Bolshoi Ballet and its school for over 70 years?

elements.title: Eternity in Flames (Wikipedia — did you know?)
